speaker: abel_garnish
text: Messenger next. Master Sincler, you are the black among the colours. The plot names you, and nobody beside you.

speaker: john_sincler
text: I have the half-line. I have been saying it into my sleeve since the parts came out.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: We are the colours. I am in the blue. Sam is left of my sleeve. The rest can stand where they were.

speaker: john_sincler
text: Then I come in. The King your father.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Dead for my life.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Hold. Do not help it. Sam, you are not in this entrance. Stand where you just learned to stand.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I am left of the nail, and I am not singing. I can be still. The note is for the other place.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I am not adding. Not to this. You will not hear a word from me until he has finished being nothing.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: You are right to keep off it. A laugh here would be a theft. I can wait. Berowne can wait.

speaker: john_sincler
text: Shall I give them more of the death? I can make a speech of a half-line if the yard is cold.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Do not. Little, and then less. You have heard the size of it already.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I answered quick, sir. Dead for my life, and I was already past it. Was that soon?

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: It was soon. Let the black arrive before the grief does. The gown can be still a moment.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: There are no extra words in the margin for this entrance, Master Will. The book is as you gave it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Slower in. Then nothing. Let them do it.

speaker: john_sincler
text: Slower. Then nothing. I can do nothing. It is the larger part of the line.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I waited. The King your father. Then, and not before. Dead for my life.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I did not move. I wanted to sing the place back into my feet. I did not.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Nor I. By my hose, that is a strange thing to be proud of, and I am a little proud of it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Again, Sincler. Do not look at us for a licence to go on. The stop is the licence.

speaker: john_sincler
text: The King your father.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Dead for my life.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: That is the size of it. Leave the rest of the comedy large. This stays small.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Entered. Messenger, black, no addition. If a word grows here on Thursday, it will not be one I wrote.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou hast said the thing that wanted saying, Will. We have it. I am not going to improve it by talking.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I still know the note, sir. And the nail. I will not bring the note into this entrance.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The gown is heavy at the hem and light at the wrist. I can wait in it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Quiet, then. I can be quiet when the thing itself is quiet. Do not ask it of me at a clown's door.

speaker: john_sincler
text: I will come slower. I will say the half-line. I will not mend it with a speech.
